items.title: ADP Q2 Deep Dive: AI Integration, International Wins, and Productivity Gains Shape Outlook
items.summary: Payroll and HR services provider Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.8% year on year to $5.47 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.64 per share was 1.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Is ADP Stock Worth Buying as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays High?

items.title: The week ahead: Jobs Report, labor market signals, and housing data in focus
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton breaks down what investors should watch in the week ahead, including key indicators on the labor and housing markets. The economic calendar features Tuesday's JOLTS report, Wednesday's MBA Mortgage Applications data, which track housing activity, and July's Jobs Report on Friday.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Turn Down
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
